notes: ~480Hz with R-OUT-PROT. Film not X7R: DC bias coefficient moves the corner 30% at 10V. ON THE JACK SIDE of R-OUT-PROT, never the op-amp side - inside the loop it is a capacitive load and the stage can oscillate.

description: Panel breath GAIN - attenuator ahead of the summer
notes: Attenuator, NOT a feedback rheostat - a rheostat makes gain and offset share a resistor and the knobs fight, which is the coupling the REF trimmer removes one stage upstream. 0.125 to 1.000 against a fixed x4 = 0.5 to 4.0 at the jack. *** WIPER MUST BE BUFFERED: *** it drives R-IN, so an unbuffered wiper makes the gain depend on a source impedance that varies with rotation. LINEAR, and the reason is on breath-output-stage.md ('Values'): with R-GAIN-FLOOR under the track the gain is linear in rotation and the design's working gain sits near noon. SONG HUEI R0904N-B50K L-25 KC [ds R0904N.pdf p.2-3]: KC IS THE 18-TOOTH KNURLED SHAFT THE T18 KNOB NEEDS; KQ is 40-tooth [p.3]. THIS ROW OWNS THE 9 MM POT ORDER-CODE TRAPS for all three pots; POT-OFFSET and POT-RESP cite it. (1) Alpha's RV09A/RV09B letter is the ROTATIONAL ANGLE (280 vs 300 deg), not the taper [ds RV09AF-40.pdf p.1]; the R0904N is 280 deg +/-10 [ds R0904N-thonk.pdf]. (2) A centre detent is Alpha's suffix 0C and costs half the life [RV09AF-40.pdf p.1]. (3) Shaft teeth: Song Huei KC and Alpha B are 18-tooth, Song Huei KQ and Alpha K are 40-tooth. (4) Body 9.7mm wide, 5.0mm pin pitch, 10.6mm lug span; the 14mm knob is the constraint across 50.50mm, not the body. Bought from Thonk; hand-placed

description: Panel breath OFFSET - bipolar, zero at centre
notes: *** THE WIPER IS UNBUFFERED AND ITS TRUE ZERO IS NOT AT CENTRE *** - where it is, and why, is on breath-output-stage.md; the number is not restated here. NO CENTRE DETENT: a click at centre would sit away from actual zero, which is worse than none. A detent would first need the wiper buffered (a spare half exists: U-REF-BUF B), which is not done. Mark the legend's 0 where the page puts it. SONG HUEI R0904N-B10K L-25 KC (18-tooth for the T18 knob); order-code traps are on POT-GAIN

description: Sets the 0.5x floor of POT-GAIN's attenuator
notes: 7.15k under a 50k track gives 7.15/57.15 = 0.125, so the gain bottoms at 0.5x rather than zero. Without it the knob reaches a mute nobody asked for and an easy way to think the instrument is dead
